MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

3. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 10
   C. 40.5
   D. 9

4. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

7. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

9. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 36
   C. 45
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
